turns.text: Hi, can you tell me when my order will arrive? It is still being made, I think.
Hi! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order is SC-3188 and the email is helen.crowe@example.com. It ships to Berlin.

Thanks, Helen. Your order SC-3188 (Blue Stair, 30x40 cm) is still in production. Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days. Delivery to Germany then takes 5 to 8 working days, since Germany is an EU country outside Romania. The order was placed on 2026-11-16. I can't give an exact arrival date, but that is the expected timing.

rule.ro: Fiecare print este realizat la comandă în 3–5 zile lucrătoare.
rule.en: Each print is made to order in 3 to 5 working days.

rule.ro: Livrarea durează 1–2 zile lucrătoare în România și 5–8 zile lucrătoare în celelalte țări din Uniunea Europeană.
rule.en: Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries.
